_note: BridgePath-authored projects merged with the workbook import. Edit here; the workbook import does not overwrite this file.

Projects.title: Containerized Task Tracker API
Projects.description: Build a small REST API for a to-do or study-task tracker backed by a SQL database, package it with Docker, and run its tests automatically on every push.
Projects.final_deliverable: A GitHub repository with the API, a Dockerfile and docker-compose setup, automated tests running in GitHub Actions, and a README with example requests.

Projects.title: Campus Events Web App
Projects.description: Create a React front end that lists campus events from your own API, with search, filters, and a saved-events view, plus a simple service that integrates a public calendar feed.
Projects.final_deliverable: A deployed web app link and repository with the React client, the integration service, and a short write-up of how the calendar data is synced.

Projects.title: Course Success Predictor
Projects.description: Use an openly licensed student-performance dataset to explore what predicts course outcomes, then train and evaluate a simple machine learning model with clear, honest metrics.
Projects.final_deliverable: A Jupyter notebook and short report covering data cleaning, exploratory analysis, model comparison, evaluation metrics, and limitations.

Projects.title: SQL-Powered Transit Dashboard
Projects.description: Load public transit ridership or delay data into a SQL database, write analysis queries, and present the findings in a small dashboard with charts.
Projects.final_deliverable: A repository with the database load script, documented SQL queries, a dashboard or notebook of charts, and a one-page findings summary.

Projects.title: Campus App Product Brief
Projects.description: Pick a real pain point for students on your campus, research it with a short survey and interviews, and write a product requirements document with user stories and a roadmap.
Projects.final_deliverable: A product requirements document with survey results, prioritized user stories, a three-release roadmap, and success metrics.

Projects.title: Feature Sizing Model in Excel
Projects.description: Build a spreadsheet model that estimates the cost and impact of three competing features for an existing app, and write a technical spec for the winner.
Projects.final_deliverable: An Excel model with documented assumptions, a one-page recommendation, and a technical specification including a draft API outline.

Projects.title: Moving-Average Strategy Backtest
Projects.description: Use free historical price data to backtest a simple moving-average crossover strategy, compare it to buy-and-hold, and explain the results with basic statistics.
Projects.final_deliverable: A notebook with the backtest, performance charts, risk and return statistics, and a written discussion of assumptions and pitfalls. No live trading.

Projects.title: Portfolio Risk Calculator
Projects.description: Build a tool that takes a small stock portfolio, estimates its volatility and correlation using linear algebra, and shows how diversification changes risk.
Projects.final_deliverable: A command-line or notebook tool with a covariance-based risk model, example portfolios stored in SQL, and a short methods write-up.

Projects.title: Arduino Environmental Sensor Logger
Projects.description: Wire temperature and light sensors to a microcontroller, write C/C++ firmware to sample them, and log the data to your computer for analysis in Python.
Projects.final_deliverable: Firmware source, a wiring diagram, a Python logging and plotting script, and a short report on sensor accuracy.

Projects.title: Automated Circuit Test Bench
Projects.description: Design a simple filter or voltage-divider circuit, then automate measurements with Python so the bench records and compares readings against your design calculations.
Projects.final_deliverable: A schematic, a measurement automation script, recorded data, and a report comparing measured and expected behavior.

Projects.title: App Engagement KPI Report
Projects.description: Define the key metrics for a sample app, compute them from a public or synthetic event log with SQL, and present a weekly KPI report that explains what changed and why.
Projects.final_deliverable: A SQL query pack, a KPI dashboard or notebook, and a one-page weekly report with insights and recommended actions.

Projects.title: AI-Assisted Data Cleaning Notebook
Projects.description: Clean a messy public dataset with help from an AI coding assistant, verifying every suggestion with tests, and document where the assistant helped and where it was wrong.
Projects.final_deliverable: A notebook with the cleaning pipeline, validation checks, and a log comparing AI suggestions with what you kept.

Projects.title: Game Outcome Probability Model
Projects.description: Use public historical sports results to estimate win probabilities with a statistical model, then check how well-calibrated the predictions are.
Projects.final_deliverable: A notebook with the model, calibration charts, and a write-up comparing your probabilities to actual outcomes.

Projects.title: Serverless Study Timer on AWS
Projects.description: Build a small study-timer API with Node.js, deploy it to AWS using managed services, and describe the cloud setup in code so anyone can recreate it.
Projects.final_deliverable: A repository with the Node.js API, infrastructure-as-code templates, a live endpoint, and an architecture diagram.

Projects.title: Algorithms Visualizer
Projects.description: Build a React app that animates sorting and graph-search algorithms step by step, with notes on time and space complexity.
Projects.final_deliverable: A deployed web app and repository with at least four animated algorithms, unit tests for each, and complexity notes.

Milestones.title: Design the API
Milestones.instructions: List the resources (tasks, users) and write out each endpoint with its method, inputs, and responses before coding.
Milestones.deliverable: An API design section in the README

Milestones.title: Build endpoints on a SQL database
Milestones.instructions: Implement create, read, update, and delete endpoints that store tasks in SQLite or PostgreSQL.
Milestones.deliverable: Working endpoints and a schema file

Milestones.title: Containerize it
Milestones.instructions: Write a Dockerfile and docker-compose file so the API and database start with one command.

Milestones.title: Automate tests
Milestones.instructions: Write tests for each endpoint and run them in GitHub Actions on every push.
Milestones.deliverable: Test suite and a passing CI badge

Milestones.title: Sketch the screens
Milestones.instructions: Draw the event list, filters, and saved-events views, and decide what data each needs.

Milestones.title: Build the React client
Milestones.instructions: Build components for the list, search, and filters, loading data from a mock API first.
Milestones.deliverable: A working client with mock data

Milestones.title: Integrate a calendar feed
Milestones.instructions: Write a small service that pulls a public calendar feed, normalizes the events, and serves them as JSON.

Milestones.title: Deploy and document
Milestones.instructions: Deploy the app and write a README covering setup, architecture, and known limits.

Milestones.title: Explore the data
Milestones.instructions: Load the dataset with pandas, check for missing values, and chart how each feature relates to outcomes.

Milestones.title: Set a baseline
Milestones.instructions: Split train and test data and measure a simple baseline so you know what “better” means.

Milestones.title: Train and compare models
Milestones.instructions: Train two or three models, compare them with cross-validation, and pick one with a clear reason.

Milestones.title: Report honestly
Milestones.instructions: Write up findings, limitations, and any fairness concerns in plain language.

Milestones.title: Load the data
Milestones.instructions: Download a public transit dataset and load it into SQLite or PostgreSQL with a script.

Milestones.title: Ask questions in SQL
Milestones.instructions: Write at least five queries that answer real questions, such as which routes are most delayed and when.

Milestones.title: Visualize results
Milestones.instructions: Turn your query results into clear charts with titles, labels, and units.

Milestones.title: Summarize findings
Milestones.instructions: Write a one-page summary with your top three findings and how confident you are in each.

Milestones.title: Research the problem
Milestones.instructions: Run a short survey of 20+ students and five quick interviews about one campus pain point.

Milestones.title: Write user stories
Milestones.instructions: Turn your research into prioritized user stories with acceptance criteria.

Milestones.title: Draft the PRD
Milestones.instructions: Write the problem, goals, non-goals, requirements, and success metrics in a requirements document.

Milestones.title: Plan the roadmap
Milestones.instructions: Group stories into three releases and explain the order you chose.

Milestones.title: Define the options
Milestones.instructions: Pick an app you use and describe three feature ideas with their target users.

Milestones.title: Build the Excel model
Milestones.instructions: Estimate reach, impact, effort, and cost for each feature with clearly labeled assumptions.

Milestones.title: Recommend one
Milestones.instructions: Write a one-page recommendation that uses the model and names the biggest risks.

Milestones.title: Write the tech spec
Milestones.instructions: Describe the winning feature's data, screens, and a draft API with example requests.

Milestones.title: Get price data
Milestones.instructions: Download several years of daily prices for one index fund and load them with pandas.

Milestones.title: Code the strategy
Milestones.instructions: Compute short and long moving averages and generate buy and sell signals without look-ahead bias.

Milestones.title: Backtest and compare
Milestones.instructions: Simulate returns with transaction costs and compare against buy-and-hold.

Milestones.title: Measure risk
Milestones.instructions: Report annualized return, volatility, Sharpe ratio, and max drawdown, and discuss overfitting.

Milestones.title: Store sample portfolios
Milestones.instructions: Create a small SQL table of example portfolios with tickers and weights.

Milestones.title: Estimate the covariance matrix
Milestones.instructions: Compute daily returns and the covariance matrix for the holdings.

Milestones.title: Compute portfolio risk
Milestones.instructions: Use the weights and covariance matrix to compute portfolio volatility, and show how it changes as you diversify.
Milestones.deliverable: Risk results with a diversification chart

Milestones.title: Write up the method
Milestones.instructions: Explain the model, its assumptions, and where it can mislead.

Milestones.title: Wire the sensors
Milestones.instructions: Connect a temperature sensor and a light sensor to the microcontroller and draw the wiring diagram.

Milestones.title: Write the firmware
Milestones.instructions: Write C/C++ firmware that samples both sensors on a fixed interval and prints readings over serial.

Milestones.title: Log data in Python
Milestones.instructions: Read the serial stream in Python, save it to CSV, and plot readings over time.

Milestones.title: Check accuracy
Milestones.instructions: Compare your readings to a reference thermometer and report the error.

Milestones.title: Design the circuit
Milestones.instructions: Design an RC filter or voltage divider and calculate its expected behavior.

Milestones.title: Build and measure by hand
Milestones.instructions: Build the circuit and take a few manual readings with a multimeter or oscilloscope.
Milestones.resource_title: SparkFun: How to use a multimeter

Milestones.title: Automate measurements
Milestones.instructions: Use Python to control the instrument or a data-acquisition board and record a sweep of readings.

Milestones.title: Compare to design
Milestones.instructions: Plot measured against expected values and explain any differences.

Milestones.title: Define the metrics
Milestones.instructions: Pick an app and define 5–7 KPIs (activation, retention, engagement) with exact formulas.

Milestones.title: Build the event data
Milestones.instructions: Load a public or synthetic event log into SQLite with users, sessions, and events tables.

Milestones.title: Compute KPIs in SQL
Milestones.instructions: Write one query per KPI, including week-over-week retention cohorts.

Milestones.title: Report the week
Milestones.instructions: Chart the KPIs and write a short report on what moved and what to do next.

Milestones.title: Pick a messy dataset
Milestones.instructions: Choose an openly licensed dataset with missing values, inconsistent formats, and duplicates.

Milestones.title: Clean with an assistant
Milestones.instructions: Use an AI assistant to draft cleaning code, and record each prompt and suggestion.

Milestones.title: Verify everything
Milestones.instructions: Write checks (row counts, ranges, uniqueness) that prove the cleaned data is right.

Milestones.title: Reflect
Milestones.instructions: Write up where the assistant saved time, where it was wrong, and how you caught it.

Milestones.title: Collect results
Milestones.instructions: Gather a few seasons of public game results and build features such as recent form and home advantage.

Milestones.title: Start with statistics
Milestones.instructions: Fit a logistic regression and interpret what each coefficient means.

Milestones.title: Try a better model
Milestones.instructions: Compare against a tree-based model using log loss on held-out seasons.

Milestones.title: Check calibration
Milestones.instructions: Plot predicted versus actual win rates and explain where the model is over- or under-confident.

Milestones.title: Build the API locally
Milestones.instructions: Write a Node.js API to start, stop, and list study sessions.

Milestones.title: Learn the AWS pieces
Milestones.instructions: Set up a free-tier account and learn Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB basics.

Milestones.title: Deploy with code
Milestones.instructions: Describe the infrastructure in a template and deploy the API to AWS.

Milestones.title: Document the architecture
Milestones.instructions: Draw how requests flow and note costs, limits, and how to tear it down.

Milestones.title: Implement the algorithms
Milestones.instructions: Write sorting (merge, quick) and search (BFS, DFS) algorithms as plain functions with tests.

Milestones.title: Record each step
Milestones.instructions: Have each algorithm emit the steps it takes so they can be replayed.

Milestones.title: Animate in React
Milestones.instructions: Build controls to play, pause, and step through each algorithm visually.

Milestones.title: Explain complexity
Milestones.instructions: Add notes comparing best, average, and worst cases for each algorithm.
